title: Prove recursive native-bank capacity at every allocation prefix (no new κ)
body:
Remove the numerical-inventory clause from the historical dimension-64, rank-at-most-42 physical caller in #2809/#2899, retained by #3385/#3627. Every finite execution prefix before a separate noncapacity error has pending demand at most 37,682 residue Words and 78 index Words, including the requested slot before its guard. Capacities 65,536/128 suffice; the source's 2^24 banks are ample.

#2835 supplies the closed coefficient prefixes. The new proof covers the changed recursive Machine: pre-parking grants, four saved leaf-boundary copies, projected coordinates, parent serialization, and restoration of the original slots under arbitrary erased warm free-list order. Recursion depth does not multiply live inventory. This answers the changed-caller/physical-parent limitation left separate in #5191; the first-range whole-caller theorem of #2845 is not transplanted. No successful unlimited-capacity run is assumed.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a. #2809: e7d93dd0de0bb81308bc3356f65eddeeb22fd712; #2899: 2f0911ad735643a069b9790302fbf179e49f74f8; #2835: a06f5339a1ee22017f6099cb1dfc1c93c212c424. SOURCES.json pins all 21 inputs; seven coefficient modules are byte-identical to the credited proof's sources.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, standard library):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/recursive-physical-capacity-prefix
```
Expected: PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE, with the complete typed receipt in normal and optimized modes.

Executed: both registered commands, independently rerun on the frozen commit; separate source/lifetime and first-failure review; canonical input and committed-byte checks. Cold/warm PhysicalArena runs execute actual selected cuts 256→168→84 with emitted directories and exact parent identity restoration. They use a controlled 23-bit child output, not a full selected GL64 payload. Short banks reject pending demands 27/26 indices and 15/14 residues. Other controls reject extra root residents, warm module aliases, omitted structural fields, wrong budgets and Boolean/integer receipt substitutions.

No new κ. Canonical words, arithmetic margins, source/ownership semantics and neutral observers remain premises. Other resource/codec failures stop the theorem. It proves neither termination nor the complete physical action/visited-space invoice; encoded ancestors and erased backing remain charged. Current #6030 geometry is not admitted. The AST inventory supports a written proof, not a general resource analyzer or proof kernel. Open work: remaining semantic/word-margin admission, complete runtime invoice, and an explicit current-supplier transfer.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI source review. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, David Arias, Ross Richardson, JoyboyBrian and ywz65 for the caller, prefixes, parking and physical banks (#2809, #2753, #2835, #5191, #2635, #2899). Apache-2.0.
